Kyiv hit by Russian drone attack, 10 injured

Kyiv was struck by a Russian drone attack that injured 10 people and caused a fire in a high-rise building. The attack disrupted daily life in the Ukrainian capital, forcing residents to adapt to constant threats. The incident highlights the ongoing impact of the conflict on civilians. Specific details on the extent of the damage to the building were not fully elaborated, but the attack caused a significant disruption.
